text: Once upon a time, in a big sandy desert, there lived a little camel named Cami.
Cami loved to bounce. Boing! Boing! Boing!
One sunny day, Cami found something amazing. The great, big, blue sea!
Splash! Up popped a friendly fish named Finn.
They bounced a big beach ball, all afternoon long.
And as the sun went down, the two new best friends danced by the sea.
The end. See you next time, little star!
